title.en: DoorDash to acquire Instacart for $17 billion in cash-and-stock deal
title.zh_hant: DoorDash 斥資 170 億美元收購 Instacart　每股作價 65 美元
title.zh_hans: DoorDash 斥资 170 亿美元收购 Instacart　每股作价 65 美元

summary.en: DoorDash announced on Thursday that it has agreed to acquire grocery delivery rival Instacart for $65 per share, an equity value of about $17 billion, in a definitive agreement approved by both companies' boards. At least 75 per cent of the consideration will be paid in cash, with DoorDash stock capped at 25 per cent; the price represents a 26 per cent premium to Instacart's October 22 closing price. DoorDash said it will keep the Instacart brand, app and enterprise technology products, and the two companies will continue to operate separately until the deal closes, expected toward the end of 2027 or in the first half of 2028. The combination pairs DoorDash's restaurant-delivery network with Instacart's grocery platform as delivery consolidation accelerates against rivals such as Uber, Amazon and Walmart.
summary.zh_hant: DoorDash 於星期四宣布，已同意以每股 65 美元、總值約 170 億美元收購雜貨外送對手 Instacart，交易已獲兩間公司董事會批准。代價至少七成半以現金支付，DoorDash 股票佔比上限為四分一；作價較 Instacart 於 10 月 22 日的收市價溢價 26%。DoorDash 表示會保留 Instacart 品牌、應用程式及企業技術產品，交易完成前兩間公司會繼續獨立營運，預計於 2027 年底或 2028 年上半年完成交割。這宗合併將 DoorDash 的餐飲外送網絡與 Instacart 的雜貨平台結合，應對 Uber、Amazon 及 Walmart 等對手的競爭。
summary.zh_hans: DoorDash 于星期四宣布，已同意以每股 65 美元、总值约 170 亿美元收购杂货外送对手 Instacart，交易已获两间公司董事会批准。代价至少七成半以现金支付，DoorDash 股票占比上限为四分之一；作价较 Instacart 于 10 月 22 日的收市价溢价 26%。DoorDash 表示会保留 Instacart 品牌、应用程序及企业技术产品，交易完成前两间公司会继续独立营运，预计于 2027 年底或 2028 年上半年完成交割。这宗合并将 DoorDash 的餐饮外送网络与 Instacart 的杂货平台结合，应对 Uber、Amazon 及 Walmart 等对手的竞争。

title.en: Amazon, Intel tumble after earnings as AI spending worries investors
title.zh_hant: Amazon 及 Intel 業績後急挫　市場憂慮 AI 開支燒錢
title.zh_hans: Amazon 及 Intel 业绩后急挫　市场忧虑 AI 开支烧钱

summary.en: Amazon shares fell more than 6% in after-hours trading on Thursday after the e-commerce giant's third-quarter results missed Wall Street expectations, with revenue of $201.9 billion up 12% and earnings per share of $1.89. Its cloud arm AWS grew 39% to $46 billion, the fastest pace in nearly five years, but investors balked at negative free cash flow of $42.4 billion as the company reaffirmed plans to spend about $220 billion this year, mostly on AI infrastructure. Intel fared worse: third-quarter revenue rose 21% to $16.5 billion, but weak fourth-quarter guidance of $15 billion to $16 billion sent the stock down as much as 20% after hours. The selloff, which also dragged Nasdaq futures lower, capped a bruising week for tech after Alphabet's own spending-fuelled slide.
summary.zh_hant: Amazon 星期四收市後公布第三季業績，收入 2019 億美元、按年增長 12%，每股盈利 1.89 美元，雙雙遜於華爾街預期，股價盤後急跌逾 6%。雲業務 AWS 收入大增 39% 至 460 億美元，創近五年最快增速，但公司維持全年約 2200 億美元資本開支（主要投向 AI 基建），過去 12 個月自由現金流轉為負 424 億美元，令投資者卻步。Intel 更慘：第三季收入按年升 21% 至 165 億美元，但第四季指引僅 150 至 160 億美元，遠遜預期，股價盤後最多跌兩成。連同早前 Alphabet 的急跌，科技股迎來難熬一週，納指期貨亦受壓。
summary.zh_hans: Amazon 星期四收市后公布第三季业绩，收入 2019 亿美元、按年增长 12%，每股盈利 1.89 美元，双双逊于华尔街预期，股价盘后急跌逾 6%。云业务 AWS 收入大增 39% 至 460 亿美元，创近五年最快增速，但公司维持全年约 2200 亿美元资本开支（主要投向 AI 基建），过去 12 个月自由现金流转为负 424 亿美元，令投资者却步。Intel 更惨：第三季收入按年升 21% 至 165 亿美元，但第四季指引仅 150 至 160 亿美元，远逊预期，股价盘后最多跌两成。连同早前 Alphabet 的急跌，科技股迎来难熬一周，纳指期货亦受压。

title.en: Russian drone strike on Dnipro train station kills at least 14
title.zh_hant: 俄羅斯無人機襲擊第聶伯羅火車站　至少 14 人死亡
title.zh_hans: 俄罗斯无人机袭击第聂伯罗火车站　至少 14 人死亡

summary.en: A Russian jet-powered drone struck a crowded platform at the main railway station in Dnipro, Ukraine, on Thursday, killing at least 14 people as a commuter train prepared to depart for Zaporizhzhia, Ukrainian officials said. At least 14 more were wounded, including an 11-year-old boy, in what authorities called one of the deadliest single strikes on Ukrainian passenger rail this year. Five more people were killed in daytime strikes elsewhere — two teenage girls in Chernihiv and three in an apartment building in Kremenchuk. President Volodymyr Zelensky posted images of the aftermath and called on the United States, Europe and the G7 to tighten sanctions, while a fragile six-day humanitarian truce in the Kherson region held elsewhere.
summary.zh_hant: 烏克蘭官員表示，俄羅斯一架噴射式無人機星期四擊中第聶伯羅中央火車站一個擠滿乘客的月台，當時一班開往扎波羅熱的通勤列車正準備出發，至少 14 人死亡。另有至少 14 人受傷，包括一名 11 歲男童，是今年針對烏克蘭客運鐵路最致命的單一襲擊之一。同日其他地區的日間襲擊再造成 5 人死亡，包括車尼希夫兩名十幾歲少女及克列緬丘格一幢住宅大樓 3 人。總統澤連斯基公開現場相片，呼籲美國、歐洲及七國集團收緊對俄制裁；與此同時，赫爾松地區為期六天的人道主義停火仍在維持。
summary.zh_hans: 乌克兰官员表示，俄罗斯一架喷射式无人机星期四击中第聂伯罗中央火车站一个挤满乘客的月台，当时一班开往扎波罗热的通勤列车正准备出发，至少 14 人死亡。另有至少 14 人受伤，包括一名 11 岁男童，是今年针对乌克兰客运铁路最致命的单一袭击之一。同日其他地区的日间袭击再造成 5 人死亡，包括切尔尼戈夫两名十几岁少女及克列缅丘格一幢住宅大楼 3 人。总统泽连斯基公开现场相片，呼吁美国、欧洲及七国集团收紧对俄制裁；与此同时，赫尔松地区为期六天的人道主义停火仍在维持。

title.en: PAG to buy 51% stake in Evergrande Property Services for HK$4.03 billion
title.zh_hant: PAG 擬 40.26 億元收購恒大物業 51% 股權　成新控股股東
title.zh_hans: PAG 拟 40.26 亿元收购恒大物业 51% 股权　成新控股股东

summary.en: China Evergrande plans to sell a roughly 51% stake in Evergrande Property Services to alternative investment firm PAG for HK$4.026 billion, making PAG the new controlling shareholder. PAG will also make a general offer to other shareholders at HK$0.8359 per share, about 29.5% below Wednesday's closing price. The company says it will stay listed with no major changes to its operations, subject to regulatory approval.
summary.zh_hant: 中國恒大公布，計劃向另類投資公司 PAG 出售恒大物業約 51% 股權，總代價 40.26 億港元，PAG 將成為恒大物業新控股股東。PAG 同時向其他股東提出全面收購，每股作價 0.8359 元，較周三收市價折讓近三成。恒大物業表示交易完成後會維持上市地位，業務營運暫無重大變動；交易仍待監管機構批准。
summary.zh_hans: 中国恒大公布，计划向另类投资公司 PAG 出售恒大物业约 51% 股权，总代价 40.26 亿港元，PAG 将成为恒大物业新控股股东。PAG 同时向其他股东提出全面收购，每股作价 0.8359 元，较周三收市价折让近三成。恒大物业表示交易完成后会维持上市地位，业务营运暂无重大变动；交易仍待监管机构批准。

title.en: North Korea fires around 10 ballistic missiles off east coast, Seoul says
title.zh_hant: 北韓向東部海域發射約 10 枚彈道導彈　首爾稱射程約 250 公里
title.zh_hans: 北韩向东部海域发射约 10 枚弹道导弹　首尔称射程约 250 公里

summary.en: South Korea's Joint Chiefs of Staff said North Korea fired around 10 short-range ballistic missiles from near Wonsan on its east coast at about 12:30pm Thursday, each flying roughly 250km into the eastern waters. Japan's defence ministry also detected the suspected launches, saying the projectiles fell outside Japan's exclusive economic zone. Seoul's presidential National Security Office held an emergency meeting; it was Pyongyang's first ballistic missile test since October 12 and its more than 10th weapons test this year.
summary.zh_hant: 韓國聯合參謀本部表示，北韓於星期四中午約 12 時半，從東岸元山一帶向東部海域發射約 10 枚短程彈道導彈，每枚飛行約 250 公里。日本防衛省亦偵測到疑似彈道導彈發射，指物體落在日本專屬經濟區之外。韓國總統府國家安全室召開緊急會議評估局勢；這是北韓自 10 月 12 日以來再次試射導彈，今年已超過 10 次。
summary.zh_hans: 韩国联合参谋本部表示，北韩于星期四中午约 12 时半，从东岸元山一带向东部海域发射约 10 枚短程弹道导弹，每枚飞行约 250 公里。日本防卫省亦侦测到疑似弹道导弹发射，指物体落在日本专属经济区之外。韩国总统府国家安全室召开紧急会议评估局势；这是北韩自 10 月 12 日以来再次试射导弹，今年已超过 10 次。

title.en: Mainland woman jailed 9 months for smuggling 71,000 duty-not-paid cigarettes
title.zh_hant: 內地女旅客走私 7.1 萬支未完稅香煙　判監 9 個月罰款 2,000 元
title.zh_hans: 内地女旅客走私 7.1 万支未完税香烟　判监 9 个月罚款 2,000 元

summary.en: A 27-year-old Mainland woman who flew into Hong Kong from Bangkok was intercepted at Hong Kong International Airport yesterday, with about 71,000 duty-not-paid cigarettes found in her personal baggage. The haul had an estimated market value of $320,000 and a duty potential of about $240,000. She was sentenced today at the West Kowloon Magistrates' Courts to nine months' imprisonment and fined $2,000. Customs said the custodial sentence carries a strong deterrent effect, and reminded the public that importing, possessing or dealing in duty-not-paid cigarettes carries a maximum penalty of a $2 million fine and seven years' imprisonment.
summary.zh_hant: 一名 27 歲內地女旅客昨日由泰國曼谷飛抵香港，在香港國際機場被海關截查，行李內搜出約 7.1 萬支未完稅香煙，市值約 32 萬元，應課稅款約 24 萬元。她今日在西九龍裁判法院被判監 9 個月及罰款 2,000 元。海關表示判刑具相當阻嚇作用，反映罪行嚴重性；並提醒市民，進口、管有、處理、售賣或購買未完稅香煙均屬違法，最高可罰款 200 萬元及監禁 7 年。
summary.zh_hans: 一名 27 岁内地女旅客昨日由泰国曼谷飞抵香港，在香港国际机场被海关截查，行李内搜出约 7.1 万支未完税香烟，市值约 32 万元，应课税款约 24 万元。她今日在西九龙裁判法院被判监 9 个月及罚款 2,000 元。海关表示判刑具相当阻吓作用，反映罪行严重性；并提醒市民，进口、管有、处理、售卖或购买未完税香烟均属违法，最高可罚款 200 万元及监禁 7 年。

title.en: 10th Hong Kong-Shanghai financial co-operation meeting held in Shanghai; MOU signed on dispute resolution
title.zh_hant: 滬港金融合作第十次工作會議上海舉行　簽備忘錄加強金融糾紛調解合作
title.zh_hans: 沪港金融合作第十次工作会议上海举行　签备忘录加强金融纠纷调解合作

summary.en: The 10th Working Meeting of Hong Kong-Shanghai Financial Co-operation was held in Shanghai today. Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury Christopher Hui led Hong Kong's financial regulators in talks with Shanghai counterparts, led by Li Junjie of the Shanghai Office for Advancing International Financial Center Development, on market connectivity, cross-boundary Renminbi business, commodities, gold and futures markets, insurance and talent exchanges. Hui witnessed the signing of an MOU between Hong Kong's Financial Dispute Resolution Centre and its Shanghai counterpart to promote alternative dispute resolution for financial disputes. Hui also met the new chairman of the Shanghai Gold Exchange, Guo Dayong, during the visit.
summary.zh_hant: 第十屆滬港金融合作工作會議今日在上海舉行。財經事務及庫務局局長許正宇率領本港金融監管機構代表，與上海市推進國際金融中心建設辦公室主任李俊傑等上海方面代表，商討加強兩地金融市場互聯互通、跨境人民幣業務、商品黃金期貨市場、保險合作及人才交流。許正宇見證香港金融糾紛調解中心與上海金融消費糾紛調解中心簽署合作備忘錄，推動金融糾紛替代性爭議解決機制。訪滬期間，許正宇亦會晤上海黃金交易所新任理事長郭大勇。
summary.zh_hans: 第十届沪港金融合作工作会议今日在上海举行。财经事务及库务局局长许正宇率领本港金融监管机构代表，与上海市推进国际金融中心建设办公室主任李俊杰等上海方面代表，商讨加强两地金融市场互联互通、跨境人民币业务、商品黄金期货市场、保险合作及人才交流。许正宇见证香港金融纠纷调解中心与上海金融消费纠纷调解中心签署合作备忘录，推动金融纠纷替代性争议解决机制。访沪期间，许正宇亦会晤上海黄金交易所新任理事长郭大勇。

title.en: New yearbook "Hong Kong 2025" goes on sale, priced at $440, featuring Kai Tak Sports Park on cover
title.zh_hant: 新年刊《香港 2025》今日開售　封面主打啟德體育園　定價 440 元
title.zh_hans: 新年刊《香港 2025》今日开售　封面主打启德体育园　定价 440 元

summary.en: The government's latest yearbook, "Hong Kong 2025", went on sale today at $440, with the online version available on yearbook.gov.hk. The publication reviews life in Hong Kong in 2025 across the administration, legislature, economy and society. The cover illustration features Kai Tak Sports Park, the largest sports infrastructure project ever commissioned in Hong Kong, which also headlines "Home of Mega Events", one of the yearbook's 10 photo sections. Copies are available at the online Government Bookstore and the Information Services Department's Publications Sales Unit in North Point.
summary.zh_hant: 政府新年刊《香港 2025》今日開售，售價 440 元，網上版同步上載至 yearbook.gov.hk。年刊綜述 2025 年香港在行政、立法、經濟及社會各方面的面貌。封面插圖為香港歷來最大型體育基建項目啟德體育園；全書 10 個圖片專輯之一「盛事之都」亦以體育園為主題。讀者可經網上政府書店或新聞處位於北角的刊物銷售組購買。
summary.zh_hans: 政府新年刊《香港 2025》今日开售，售价 440 元，网上版同步上载至 yearbook.gov.hk。年刊综述 2025 年香港在行政、立法、经济及社会各方面的面貌。封面插图为香港历来最大型体育基建项目启德体育园；全书 10 个图片专辑之一「盛事之都」亦以体育园为主题。读者可经网上政府书店或新闻处位于北角的刊物销售组购买。

title.en: Strive and Rise Programme opens fifth-cohort recruitment: 4,000 places, $5,000 start-up grant each
title.zh_hant: 「共創明『Teen』計劃」第五期今起招募　4,000 名額每人 5,000 元啟動資金
title.zh_hans: 「共创明『Teen』计划」第五期今起招募　4,000 名额每人 5,000 元启动资金

summary.en: The Strive and Rise Programme today began recruiting 4,000 mentees for its fifth cohort. Led by an interdepartmental task force under the Chief Secretary for Administration, the programme pairs underprivileged junior secondary students with volunteer mentors through a tripartite government-business-community collaboration, offering a one-year intensive foundation training. Each mentee receives $5,000 in start-up financial support, and graduates automatically join the programme's alumni association. Eligible students may apply through their schools or the NGOs assisting the programme.
summary.zh_hant: 「共創明『Teen』計劃」今日起招募第五期 4,000 名學員。計劃由政務司司長領導的跨部門專責小組制定推行，透過政、商、民三方協作，為基層初中生配對義務友師，提供為期一年密集式基礎培訓。每名學員可獲 5,000 元啟動資金，完成培訓後自動成為校友會會員。合資格學生可經學校或協助推行計劃的非政府機構報名。
summary.zh_hans: 「共创明『Teen』计划」今日起招募第五期 4,000 名学员。计划由政务司司长领导的跨部门专责小组制定推行，透过政、商、民三方协作，为基层初中生配对义务友师，提供为期一年密集式基础培训。每名学员可获 5,000 元启动资金，完成培训后自动成为校友会会员。合资格学生可经学校或协助推行计划的非政府机构报名。

title.en: Heated water at 30 public swimming pools from November 8
title.zh_hant: 康文署 30 個公眾泳池 11 月 8 日起供應暖水
title.zh_hans: 康文署 30 个公众泳池 11 月 8 日起供应暖水

summary.en: The Leisure and Cultural Services Department announced today that 30 public swimming pools under its management will provide heated water from November 8, so swimmers can keep swimming through the winter. Details of opening arrangements and weekly cleaning schedules are available on the department's website.
summary.zh_hant: 康樂及文化事務署今日宣布，轄下 30 個公眾游泳池將於 11 月 8 日起供應暖水，方便市民在冬季繼續游泳。各泳池開放安排及每周清潔時間詳情，可查閱康文署網頁。
summary.zh_hans: 康乐及文化事务署今日宣布，辖下 30 个公众游泳池将于 11 月 8 日起供应暖水，方便市民在冬季继续游泳。各泳池开放安排及每周清洁时间详情，可查阅康文署网页。

title.en: HKMAO commentary hails Hong Kong government's accountability over Wang Fuk Court fire
title.zh_hant: 港澳辦「港澳平」發文　肯定特區政府嚴肅追責問責　展現擔當勇氣
title.zh_hans: 港澳办「港澳平」发文　肯定特区政府严肃追责问责　展现担当勇气

summary.en: The Hong Kong and Macao Affairs Office published a commentary under the byline "Gang Ao Ping" today, endorsing the Hong Kong government's handling of the Wang Fuk Court fire. It said the government's public apology, criminal prosecutions, administrative accountability and the political responsibility taken by officials were serious, fair and proportionate, fully demonstrating a responsible government's courage. The article noted 99.3% of affected owners have accepted the government's buyout offer, and said the building-maintenance loopholes exposed by the fire are deep-rooted institutional problems accumulated over years that can only be fixed through thorough systemic reform.
summary.zh_hant: 中央港澳辦、國務院港澳辦今日發表署名「港澳平」文章，肯定特區政府就大埔宏福苑火災向公眾道歉，並按獨立委員會報告作出刑事追責、行政問責及政治責任承擔。文章形容三個層面的追責問責嚴肅認真、實事求是、責罰相適，充分體現負責任政府的擔當和勇氣。文章又指，已有 99.3% 宏福苑業主接受政府收購方案；火災暴露的樓宇維修制度漏洞及監管權責不清，屬長期積累的體制深層次問題，必須「刮骨療傷」深化系統性改革才能根治。
summary.zh_hans: 中央港澳办、国务院港澳办今日发表署名「港澳平」文章，肯定特区政府就大埔宏福苑火灾向公众道歉，并按独立委员会报告作出刑事追责、行政问责及政治责任承担。文章形容三个层面的追责问责严肃认真、实事求是、责罚相适，充分体现负责任政府的担当和勇气。文章又指，已有 99.3% 宏福苑业主接受政府收购方案；火灾暴露的楼宇维修制度漏洞及监管权责不清，属长期积累的体制深层次问题，必须「刮骨疗伤」深化系统性改革才能根治。

title.en: Immigration Department arrests 10 in territory-wide anti-illegal worker operations
title.zh_hant: 入境處全港反非法勞工行動拘 10 人　8 名疑似黑工包括持擔保書者
title.zh_hans: 入境处全港反非法劳工行动拘 10 人　8 名疑似黑工包括持担保书者

summary.en: The Immigration Department mounted a series of territory-wide anti-illegal worker operations from October 23 to 29, including joint operations with the Police, the Food and Environmental Hygiene Department and the Leisure and Cultural Services Department. Officers raided restaurants, flats under renovation and massage parlours, arresting eight suspected illegal workers — all women aged 25 to 63, two of whom held recognisance forms barring them from employment — as well as a 63-year-old woman suspected of employing them and a 26-year-old male overstayer. The department warned that breaching a condition of stay is an offence and that visitors are not allowed to take any employment in Hong Kong, paid or unpaid.
summary.zh_hant: 入境事務處於 10 月 23 日至 29 日展開一連串全港反非法勞工行動，包括與警務處、食物環境衞生署及康樂及文化事務署的聯合行動，代號分別為「暮光」、「冠軍」及「愕然」。行動中突擊搜查多個目標地點，包括食肆、裝修中單位及按摩院，共拘捕 8 名疑似非法勞工（均為 25 至 63 歲女子，其中兩人持不准僱用工作的擔保書）、一名 63 歲疑聘用黑工的女子，以及一名 26 歲逾期逗留男子。入境處發言人強調，任何人違反逗留條件即屬違法，訪客不論有薪或無薪均不得在港工作。
summary.zh_hans: 入境事务处于 10 月 23 日至 29 日展开一连串全港反非法劳工行动，包括与警务处、食物环境卫生署及康乐及文化事务署的联合行动，代号分别为「暮光」、「冠军」及「愕然」。行动中突击搜查多个目标地点，包括食肆、装修中单位及按摩院，共拘捕 8 名疑似非法劳工（均为 25 至 63 岁女子，其中两人持不准雇用工作的担保书）、一名 63 岁疑聘用黑工的女子，以及一名 26 岁逾期逗留男子。入境处发言人强调，任何人违反逗留条件即属违法，访客不论有薪或无薪均不得在港工作。

title.en: Customs seizes suspected endangered live bird at Lo Wu; 70-year-old man intercepted
title.zh_hant: 海關羅湖截七旬漢　行李搜出疑瀕危物種活雀鳥
title.zh_hans: 海关罗湖截七旬汉　行李搜出疑濒危物种活雀鸟

summary.en: Hong Kong Customs yesterday seized a live bird of a suspected scheduled endangered species, with an estimated market value of about HK$4,000, at the Lo Wu Control Point. Officers intercepted a 70-year-old local male passenger at the arrival hall and found the bird in his personal baggage; Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department officers preliminarily identified it as an endangered species regulated under the Convention on International Trade in Endangered Species. The case has been handed to the AFCD for follow-up. Under the Protection of Endangered Species of Animals and Plants Ordinance, offenders face a maximum fine of HK$10 million and 10 years' imprisonment.
summary.zh_hant: 香港海關昨日（10 月 29 日）在羅湖管制站截查一名 70 歲本地男旅客時，在其個人行李內搜出一隻懷疑屬附表瀕危物種的活雀鳥，估計市值約 4,000 元。漁農自然護理署人員到場初步鑑定，確認該雀鳥屬《瀕危野生動植物種國際貿易公約》附錄所列、受《保護瀕危動植物物種條例》規管的瀕危物種，案件已轉交漁護署跟進調查。根據條例，任何人非法進出口或管有瀕危物種標本，一經定罪最高可判罰款 1,000 萬元及監禁 10 年，標本會被沒收。
summary.zh_hans: 香港海关昨日（10 月 29 日）在罗湖管制站截查一名 70 岁本地男旅客时，在其个人行李内搜出一只怀疑属附表濒危物种的活雀鸟，估计市值约 4,000 元。渔农自然护理署人员到场初步鉴定，确认该雀鸟属《濒危野生动植物种国际贸易公约》附录所列、受《保护濒危动植物物种条例》规管的濒危物种，案件已转交渔护署跟进调查。根据条例，任何人非法进出口或管有濒危物种标本，一经定罪最高可判罚款 1,000 万元及监禁 10 年，标本会被没收。

title.en: Customs seizes 8,000kg of duty-not-paid manufactured tobacco at Shenzhen Bay
title.zh_hant: 海關深圳灣破走私製成煙草案　檢 8,000 公斤市值 5,340 萬
title.zh_hans: 海关深圳湾破走私制成烟草案　检 8,000 公斤市值 5,340 万

summary.en: Hong Kong Customs yesterday detected a duty-not-paid manufactured tobacco smuggling case at the Shenzhen Bay Control Point, seizing about 8,000 kilograms of manufactured tobacco with an estimated market value of HK$53.4 million and a duty potential of about HK$32 million. Acting on intelligence, officers intercepted an inbound medium goods vehicle declared to be carrying plastic films and carton sealing tapes, and found about 400 boxes of unmanifested, duty-not-paid manufactured tobacco inside. A 55-year-old male local driver was arrested. Customs said the case is still under investigation and further arrests are not ruled out.
summary.zh_hant: 香港海關昨日（10 月 29 日）在深圳灣管制站偵破一宗未完稅製成煙草走私案，檢獲約 8,000 公斤未完稅製成煙草，估計市值約 5,340 萬元，應課稅款約 3,200 萬元。海關根據情報分析，截查一輛報稱載有膠片及封箱膠紙的入境中型貨車，經檢查後發現車上藏有約 400 箱未列艙單的未完稅製成煙草，以及少量其他未申報貨物。一名 55 歲本地男司機被捕。海關表示案件仍在調查中，不排除再有人被捕。
summary.zh_hans: 香港海关昨日（10 月 29 日）在深圳湾管制站侦破一宗未完税制成烟草走私案，检获约 8,000 公斤未完税制成烟草，估计市值约 5,340 万元，应课税款约 3,200 万元。海关根据情报分析，截查一辆报称载有胶片及封箱胶纸的入境中型货车，经检查后发现车上藏有约 400 箱未列舱单的未完税制成烟草，以及少量其他未申报货物。一名 55 岁本地男司机被捕。海关表示案件仍在调查中，不排除再有人被捕。

title.en: Government proposes criminalising bid-rigging in building maintenance projects after Wang Fuk Court report
title.zh_hant: 宏福苑火災調查報告建議　政府倡立法刑事化樓宇維修圍標
title.zh_hans: 宏福苑火灾调查报告建议　政府倡立法刑事化楼宇维修围标

summary.en: Acting on the report of the Independent Committee on the Wang Fuk Court fire in Tai Po, the Security Bureau and the Commerce and Economic Development Bureau — joined by the Police, the ICAC and the Competition Commission — today announced a proposal to criminalise bid-rigging in building maintenance and renovation projects, alongside enhanced anti-bid-rigging measures. The committee's report found bid-rigging in major maintenance projects to be a serious problem in Hong Kong, with people of suspicious backgrounds, including triad groups, manipulating tender results and colluding with consultants, professionals and contractors in corruption and fraud. The government will pursue reform through a three-pronged approach: legislative amendments, law-enforcement co-ordination and frontline prevention.
summary.zh_hant: 就大埔宏福苑火災獨立委員會的報告，保安局與商務及經濟發展局今日（10 月 30 日）聯同警務處、廉政公署及競爭事務委員會，公布建議將樓宇維修及翻新工程的圍標行為刑事化，並加強打擊圍標的措施。委員會報告指出，本港大型樓宇維修工程圍標問題嚴重，有可疑背景人士（包括三合會）操控投標結果，並與顧問、專業人士及承建商勾結，涉及貪污及其他欺詐行為。政府將循三方面推進改革：修訂法例、加強執法協調，以及前線預防，全方位嚴厲打擊樓宇維修圍標。
summary.zh_hans: 就大埔宏福苑火灾独立委员会的报告，保安局与商务及经济发展局今日（10 月 30 日）联同警务处、廉政公署及竞争事务委员会，公布建议将楼宇维修及翻新工程的围标行为刑事化，并加强打击围标的措施。委员会报告指出，本港大型楼宇维修工程围标问题严重，有可疑背景人士（包括三合会）操控投标结果，并与顾问、专业人士及承建商勾结，涉及贪污及其他欺诈行为。政府将循三方面推进改革：修订法例、加强执法协调，以及前线预防，全方位严厉打击楼宇维修围标。

title.en: Eight applications received for ride-hailing service licences; qualified list due this year
title.zh_hant: 網約車平台牌照收 8 宗申請　運輸署料年內公布合資格名單
title.zh_hans: 网约车平台牌照收 8 宗申请　运输署料年内公布合资格名单

summary.en: The Transport Department announced today that the application period for ride-hailing service licences closed at noon, with eight applications received — which the department described as a positive industry response. An assessment committee comprising representatives from the Transport and Logistics Bureau, the Digital Policy Office and the Transport Department will assess the applications in detail, covering fleet management, booking platform services, service commencement plans, customer service, operating experience, financial capability and due-diligence plans to ensure vehicle owners and drivers comply with the owner-driver binding requirement. The committee will recommend to the Commissioner for Transport, with the list of qualified platforms expected to be announced within this year.
summary.zh_hant: 運輸署今日（10 月 30 日）宣布，網約車服務牌照申請期於今日中午截止，共收到 8 宗申請，署方形容業界反應正面。由運輸及物流局、數字政策辦公室及運輸署代表組成的評審委員會，將詳細評審各申請，包括車隊管理、預約平台服務、服務開展計劃、服務承諾、客戶服務、營運網約車平台經驗、財政能力及資本投資，以及確保車主和司機遵守「車主司機綁定」要求的盡職審查計劃等。委員會將向運輸署署長提出建議，目標於今年內公布合資格平台名單。
summary.zh_hans: 运输署今日（10 月 30 日）宣布，网约车服务牌照申请期于今日中午截止，共收到 8 宗申请，署方形容业界反应正面。由运输及物流局、数字政策办公室及运输署代表组成的评审委员会，将详细评审各申请，包括车队管理、预约平台服务、服务开展计划、服务承诺、客户服务、营运网约车平台经验、财政能力及资本投资，以及确保车主和司机遵守「车主司机绑定」要求的尽职审查计划等。委员会将向运输署署长提出建议，目标于今年内公布合资格平台名单。

title.en: 1,115 Election Committee nominations ruled valid; 856 vie for 723 seats on November 22
title.zh_hant: 選委會界別分組選舉 1,115 人提名有效　856 人爭 723 席
title.zh_hans: 选委会界别分组选举 1,115 人提名有效　856 人争 723 席

summary.en: The Candidate Eligibility Review Committee has determined that the nominations of 1,115 candidates for the 2026 Election Committee Subsector Ordinary Elections are valid, the Registration and Electoral Office announced today. Of these, 856 validly nominated candidates from 31 contested subsectors will compete for 723 seats at the polls on November 22. The 31 contested subsectors span commercial, industrial, professional and grassroots sectors, including finance, real estate and construction, tourism, technology and innovation, and representatives of area committees of Hong Kong, Kowloon and the New Territories.
summary.zh_hant: 選舉事務處今日（10 月 30 日）宣布，候選人資格審查委員會已裁定 2026 年選舉委員會界別分組一般選舉的 1,115 名候選人提名有效。其中 856 名有效提名候選人來自 31 個有競逐的界別分組，將於 11 月 22 日競逐 723 個議席。31 個有競逐的界別分組涵蓋商界、工業界、專業界及基層界別，包括金融界、地產及建造界、旅遊界、科技創新界，以及港九及新界分區委員會、地區撲滅罪行委員會及地區防火委員會委員的代表等。
summary.zh_hans: 选举事务处今日（10 月 30 日）宣布，候选人资格审查委员会已裁定 2026 年选举委员会界别分组一般选举的 1,115 名候选人提名有效。其中 856 名有效提名候选人来自 31 个有竞逐的界别分组，将于 11 月 22 日竞逐 723 个议席。31 个有竞逐的界别分组涵盖商界、工业界、专业界及基层界别，包括金融界、地产及建造界、旅游界、科技创新界，以及港九及新界分区委员会、地区扑灭罪行委员会及地区防火委员会委员的代表等。

title.en: Hang Seng closes up 1.46% at 23,294 as oil stocks rally, tech names diverge
title.zh_hant: 港股收市升 1.46% 報 23,294 點　石油股強、智譜瀉 9%
title.zh_hans: 港股收市升 1.46% 报 23,294 点　石油股强、智谱泻 9%

summary.en: Hong Kong stocks closed higher across the board on Friday, with the Hang Seng Index up 1.46% at 23,294.42 points, the Hang Seng Tech Index up 0.29% and the Hang Seng China Enterprises Index up 1.37%. Tech stocks were mixed: Meituan and Xiaomi rose more than 3% while Lenovo fell over 7%. Oil stocks outperformed, with PetroChina up more than 5% after reporting third-quarter net profit of 51.84 billion yuan, up 21.6% year on year. Tingyi also rose more than 5%. Software stocks were weak: Zhipu plunged more than 9% after Google's overnight 12.64% plunge — its biggest single-day drop since listing, wiping out nearly US$500 billion in market value.
summary.zh_hant: 港股三大指數今日收市集體上漲。截至收盤，恒生指數漲 1.46%，報 23,294.42 點；恒生科技指數漲 0.29%；國企指數漲 1.37%。盤面上科網股漲多跌少，美團、小米漲超 3%，聯想跌超 7%；石油股走強，中石油漲超 5%，該公司日前公布第三季歸母淨利潤 518.4 億元，同比增長 21.6%；食品股中康師傅漲超 5%；應用軟件板塊低迷，智譜跌超 9%。隔夜谷歌股價收跌 12.64%，創 2004 年上市以來最大單日跌幅，市值單日蒸發近 5,000 億美元。
summary.zh_hans: 港股三大指数今日收市集体上涨。截至收盘，恒生指数涨 1.46%，报 23,294.42 点；恒生科技指数涨 0.29%；国企指数涨 1.37%。盘面上科网股涨多跌少，美团、小米涨超 3%，联想跌超 7%；石油股走强，中石油涨超 5%，该公司日前公布第三季归母净利润 518.4 亿元，同比增长 21.6%；食品股中康师傅涨超 5%；应用软件板块低迷，智谱跌超 9%。隔夜谷歌股价收跌 12.64%，创 2004 年上市以来最大单日跌幅，市值单日蒸发近 5,000 亿美元。

title.en: Intel shares plunge about 20% after hours as weak Q4 guidance overshadows Q3 beat
title.zh_hant: 英特爾 Q4 財測遠遜預期　盤後股價慘崩兩成
title.zh_hans: 英特尔 Q4 财测远逊预期　盘后股价惨崩两成

summary.en: US chip giant Intel reported third-quarter results on Thursday that beat expectations — revenue of US$16.51 billion, up 21% from a year earlier, and adjusted earnings per share of 52 cents versus the 40 cents analysts expected — but issued a weak outlook that sent its shares crashing about 20% after hours. Intel guided fourth-quarter revenue of US$15–16 billion and adjusted EPS of about 25 cents, far below consensus estimates of US$17.1 billion and 43 cents. Its client computing and physical AI business saw revenue fall 5% year on year to US$8.1 billion amid soft PC demand, while data-centre and AI revenue surged 78% to US$7.3 billion on AI demand.
summary.zh_hant: 美國晶片大廠英特爾於 29 日公布第三季財報，營收與獲利均優於市場預期：營收達 165.1 億美元，略高於預期的 165 億美元，較去年同期的 137 億美元成長 21%；調整後每股盈餘 52 美分，高於分析師預期的 40 美分。然而公司對本季提出偏弱財測，拖累股價盤後崩跌約兩成。英特爾預期第四季營收介乎 150 億至 160 億美元、調整後 EPS 約 25 美分，遠不及分析師預期的 171 億美元營收與 43 美分 EPS。分部表現方面，客戶端運算與實體 AI 業務第三季營收年減 5% 至 81 億美元；資料中心與 AI 業務則受惠 AI 需求，年增 78% 達 73 億美元。
summary.zh_hans: 美国芯片大厂英特尔于 29 日公布第三季财报，营收与获利均优于市场预期：营收达 165.1 亿美元，略高于预期的 165 亿美元，较去年同期的 137 亿美元成长 21%；调整后每股盈余 52 美分，高于分析师预期的 40 美分。然而公司对本季提出偏弱财测，拖累股价盘后崩跌约两成。英特尔预期第四季营收介乎 150 亿至 160 亿美元、调整后 EPS 约 25 美分，远不及分析师预期的 171 亿美元营收与 43 美分 EPS。分部表现方面，客户端运算与实体 AI 业务第三季营收年减 5% 至 81 亿美元；资料中心与 AI 业务则受惠 AI 需求，年增 78% 达 73 亿美元。

title.en: FCC moves to bar Chinese carriers from US phone numbers; Beijing vows to respond
title.zh_hant: FCC 擬禁中資電信商接取美國電話號碼　外交部：堅決反對
title.zh_hans: FCC 拟禁中资电信商接取美国电话号码　外交部：坚决反对

summary.en: The US Federal Communications Commission announced on Thursday that it will vote on November 19 on a proposal to bar China Mobile, China Telecom, China Unicom and some IP service providers from directly accessing US telephone numbers, in a bid to curb scam-related robocalls. IP providers using equipment from Huawei, ZTE and other firms on the FCC's national-security blacklist would also fall under the ban, and from December 2028 all Chinese laboratories would be barred from testing electronic products destined for the US market. At a regular press briefing on Friday, Foreign Ministry spokesman Guo Jiakun said the US was overstretching the concept of national security and abusing state power to suppress Chinese companies, adding that China firmly opposes and strongly deplores the move and will take necessary measures to safeguard its legitimate rights and interests.
summary.zh_hant: 美國聯邦通信委員會（FCC）周四宣布，將於 11 月 19 日就一項提案進行表決，禁止中國移動、中國電信、中國聯通以及一些 IP 服務商直接接取美國的電話號碼，以遏阻與詐騙相關的自動語音電話。使用華為、中興通訊等 FCC 國安黑名單企業設備的 IP 服務商亦將納入禁令；此外，FCC 將於 2028 年 12 月起禁止所有中國實驗室測試輸美的電子產品。外交部發言人郭嘉昆今日在例行記者會回應，美方泛化國家安全概念、濫用國家力量，無理打壓中國企業，中方對此表示堅決反對、強烈不滿，將採取必要措施，堅定維護自身正當合法權益。
summary.zh_hans: 美国联邦通信委员会（FCC）周四宣布，将于 11 月 19 日就一项提案进行表决，禁止中国移动、中国电信、中国联通以及一些 IP 服务商直接接取美国的电话号码，以遏阻与诈骗相关的自动语音电话。使用华为、中兴通讯等 FCC 国安黑名单企业设备的 IP 服务商亦将纳入禁令；此外，FCC 将于 2028 年 12 月起禁止所有中国实验室测试输美的电子产品。外交部发言人郭嘉昆今日在例行记者会回应，美方泛化国家安全概念、滥用国家力量，无理打压中国企业，中方对此表示坚决反对、强烈不满，将采取必要措施，坚定维护自身正当合法权益。

title.en: Spain's first report on high-speed train crash: collision speed put at 160-200 km/h; toll rises to 69
title.zh_hant: 西班牙高鐵相撞首份報告：時速估 160 至 200 公里　死亡人數升至 69
title.zh_hans: 西班牙高铁相撞首份报告：时速估 160 至 200 公里　死亡人数升至 69

summary.en: Spain's independent rail accident investigation body on Thursday published its first report on the high-speed train collision near Toledo. The report estimates that the Renfe train was travelling at 160 to 200 km/h when it hit the stationary Iryo train, pending analysis of the on-board recorders. Carriage 8 of the Renfe train embedded itself into carriage 1 of the Iryo train, with both overturning; the Iryo train's rear three carriages fell into the embankment. The report notes a signalling-system failure that began at 8:31am, forcing control-centre staff and drivers to communicate by telephone, and stresses the investigation is at an early stage and it is too early to determine the exact cause. The latest official count puts the death toll at 69, with 50 injured still in hospital.
summary.zh_hant: 西班牙鐵路、海事和民用航空事故和事件技術調查獨立行政機構當地時間 10 月 29 日在其網站公布托萊多省高鐵事故首份報告。報告估計，西班牙國家鐵路公司（Renfe）旗下列車與停下的伊爾約（Iryo）公司列車相撞時，時速在 160 至 200 公里之間，具體數據尚待審查車載記錄儀。報告顯示，Renfe 列車的 8 號車廂嵌入 Iryo 列車的 1 號車廂，兩節車廂翻覆；Iryo 列車除前兩節車廂外其餘全部脫軌，尾部三節車廂墜入路堤。報告指出，信號系統故障始於上午 8 時 31 分，列車在沒有信號系統干預下運行，控制中心與司機須以電話溝通；調查尚處初期，斷定確切原因為时尚早。最新統計顯示事故已造成 69 人遇難，仍有 50 名傷者在各大醫院住院治療。
summary.zh_hans: 西班牙铁路、海事和民用航空事故和事件技术调查独立行政机构当地时间 10 月 29 日在其网站公布托莱多省高铁事故首份报告。报告估计，西班牙国家铁路公司（Renfe）旗下列车与停下的伊尔约（Iryo）公司列车相撞时，时速在 160 至 200 公里之间，具体数据尚待审查车载记录仪。报告显示，Renfe 列车的 8 号车厢嵌入 Iryo 列车的 1 号车厢，两节车厢翻覆；Iryo 列车除前两节车厢外其余全部脱轨，尾部三节车厢坠入路堤。报告指出，信号系统故障始于上午 8 时 31 分，列车在没有信号系统干预下运行，控制中心与司机须以电话沟通；调查尚处初期，断定确切原因为时尚早。最新统计显示事故已造成 69 人遇难，仍有 50 名伤者在各大医院住院治疗。
